arguments.content: Recovery/idempotency review pattern: entity identity and operation identity are different. With retained audit records, looking up a recovery record by workspace/entity can silently suppress every later operation for that entity and return success with a caller ID that has no record. Preserve lookup by the caller-supplied operation ID and test a fresh ID after both incomplete and completed earlier saves. Verified against the staged save recovery update relative to HEAD feeb199add2b6ae7b800a45b7b6856ab45ad2a67: existing tests all passed, but fresh-ID saves kept old values and created no new recovery record. P1.
